g.text: Figure A4-1: Use-Case Diagram - LegalCase ERP Prototype (demonstrated scope)
FR-04 / ETR-03: a document that does not belong to the case, or has no
case content, is set REJECTED with a stated reason and highlighted fields,
and is listed in the administrator rejection report.
